in_marathi.name: Chhabi
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of Fortune
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chhabi हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chhabi is a Sanskrit name derived from the Goddess of Fortune, Lakshmi. It is believed that this name brings wealth, prosperity, and good fortune to the bearer.
